content.title: Lemonade to cut insurance rates for Tesla drivers in endorsement of EV maker's software technology
content.summary: U.S. insurer Lemonade said on Wednesday it would offer a 50% rate cut for drivers of Tesla electric vehicles when the automaker's Full Self-Driving (FSD) driver assistance software is steering because ​it had data showing it reduced accidents.  Lemonade's move is an endorsement of Tesla CEO Elon Musk's claims that the company's ‌vehicle technology is safer than human drivers, despite concerns flagged by regulators and safety experts.  As part of a collaboration, Tesla is giving Lemonade access to vehicle telemetry ‌data that will be used to distinguish between miles driven by FSD - which requires a human driver's supervision - and human driving, the New York-based insurer said.
